title: Kilo Code adapter
description: Managed block in ~/.config/kilo/AGENTS.md (core rules inline, router just in time) and the five opencode-format subagents in ~/.config/kilo/agents. Skills come from ~/.agents/skills.
postInstall: Kilo Code: start a new session to load ~/.config/kilo/AGENTS.md. Until the Kilo migration runs it also falls back to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, so with Claude Code installed the core rules can load twice; run the migration or check which global files are loaded. Subagents (mode: subagent, edit denied for read-only roles) inherit the calling model; add model: provider/id per file in ~/.config/kilo/agents/. Skills: ~/.agents/skills, plus ~/.claude/skills when Claude Code compatibility is on, which can duplicate names. No hooks are installed; see components/kilo/HOOKS.md.
